properties.name: North Atlantic Ocean (GOaS)
properties.source: Flanders Marine Institute (VLIZ), Marine Regions, Global Oceans and Seas v1
properties.note: Equator to the Arctic Ocean's boundary; includes the Gulf of Mexico, the Caribbean and the North Sea, excludes the Mediterranean and the Baltic. Interior rings dropped (land inside the region is excluded by sst_daily holding ocean cells only). Longitudes are continuous across the region, on the 0-360 frame where the region allows and as negative degrees east where it crosses the prime meridian.
